run_tabfact_preprocessing: run the TabFact dataset preprocessing to generate k-shot train dev and test splits
create_tabfact_dataset: create a TabFact classification dataset instance with entailed and refuted labels
load_tabfact_hf_dataset: load the tab_fact dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
map_tabfact_to_list: map a Hugging Face TabFact dataset split to a list of statement table tuples
generate_k_shot_tabfact: generate k-shot TabFact data splits for a given seed and output path
